_: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next on its own engine (saguaro-qfn, engines/qfn): unsloth's GGUF quants of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next read in place (engines/qfn/tools/iq_pack.py indexes them: the pack), drafted by the Lamina MTP layer ("mtp" below); and CYBER-FROST-3.8-PS ("cyber-frost-q5_k_m": Blackfrost-AI's fine-tune in peasantsmith's one GGUF, its repo and commit named in the quant, the drafter built from the NextN block inside the file with tools/mtp_from_gguf.py). "revision" is the commit the files are pinned at (unsloth re-uploaded the quants on 2026-11-04; the setup's pack, configs and measurements are this revision's) and every file has its sha256: the setup checks it. "needs": the memory a quant was measured to run with on one GPU - the experts the GPU does not hold in a RAM tier of the RAM's size less 20 GB, the rest read from the SSD.
name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next

ud-q4_k_xl.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-UD-Q4_K_XL
ud-q4_k_xl.about: unsloth's UD-Q4_K_XL: the routed experts in Q4_K / Q5_K / Q6_K, 125B parameters, 10 of 512 experts a token
ud-q4_k_xl.measured: an RX 9070 XT (16 GB) with 96 GB of RAM: 27-41 tok/s answers, 520-1,080 tok/s 8K-16K prompt reads

q8_0.name: Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-Q8_0
q8_0.about: unsloth's Q8_0: every weight in 8 bits, the most accurate quant, 177 GB
q8_0.measured: an RX 9070 XT (16 GB) with 96 GB of RAM: 14-15 tok/s answers, 73-315 tok/s prompt reads (about 50 GB of its experts read from the SSD)

cyber-frost-q5_k_m.name: CYBER-FROST-3.8-PS
cyber-frost-q5_k_m.about: Blackfrost-AI's fine-tune CYBER-FROST-3.8-PS in peasantsmith's GGUF: the routed experts in Q5_K (gate/up) / IQ4_NL (down), the n-gram table IQ4_NL, its MTP (NextN) block inside (blk.48 of a block_count 49, left out of the pack: the drafter is built from it), one file, 180B parameters, 10 of 512 experts a token

vision._: Pictures: the model's vision tower as llama.cpp's mmproj, from unsloth's GGUF repo of Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next - its mmproj-BF16.gguf, the tower in its own BF16 (the same file the hand-made configs keep as mmproj-Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-BF16.gguf; the setup downloads it under that name). vision-qfn reads it with the model's GGUF opened for its vocabulary only; the encoder stays on the SSD and gets VRAM only while a picture is encoded (the config's elastic vision entry).
